hook.title: Dawa kab tak khatam hogi?
hook.md:
Ek patient ke shareer mein kisi dawa ki **100 mg** hai. Har **4 ghante** mein uska aadha hissa nikal jaata hai. Yeh samay dawa ki **half-life** hai. Kitne ghante baad **10 mg** se kam bachega?

Aapko pehle se nahi pata ki kitni baar aadha karna padega, isliye fixed `range()` wala `for` loop theek nahi baithta. Aapko aisa loop chahiye jo **tab tak** chale **jab tak** kuch sach hai. Yahi aaj ka lesson hai.

*Is lesson ke numbers Python seekhne ke liye banaaye gaye hain. Asli half-life har dawa ki alag hoti hai.*

learn: **while loop** tab tak kaise dohraata hai jab tak uski condition **True** hai
Loop **khatam** ho, yeh kaise pakka karein, aur **infinite loop** kya hai
**break** loop ko jaldi kaise rokta hai, aur **continue** ek round kaise chhodta hai

explanation.heading: Jab tak condition True hai, dohraao
explanation.md:
**while loop** apni condition jaanchta hai, `True` ho to block chalaata hai, phir wapas jaakar phir jaanchta hai. Jaise hi condition pehli baar `False` ho, yeh ruk jaata hai.

```python
amount = 100
hours = 0
while amount > 10:
    amount = amount / 2
    hours += 4
print("Below 10 mg after", hours, "hours")
```

Yeh `Below 10 mg after 16 hours` print karta hai. Amount aise ghatta hai: 100 → 50 → 25 → 12.5 → 6.25. Chauthi baar aadha karne ke baad `6.25 > 10` `False` hai, isliye loop khatam.

Syntax `if` jaisa hi hai: condition, colon, aur indent kiya block. Fark yeh hai ki `if` apna block **zyada se zyada ek baar** chalaata hai, aur `while` **baar-baar**.

callout.title: while loop
callout.md: Aisa loop jo tab tak apna block dohraata hai jab tak condition True hai. Har round se pehle condition jaanchi jaati hai.

explanation.heading: for ya while?
explanation.md:
| Use | Kab | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `for` | Values pata hain, ya kitni baar | Day 1 se 30, list ki har dawa |
| `while` | **Kuch hone tak** dohraana hai | Jab tak amount 10 mg se kam na ho, jab tak sahi number type na ho |

Kai problems dono tarah likhi ja sakti hain, par sahi chunaav program ko chhota aur saaf banaata hai.

explanation.heading: Pakka kijiye ki loop khatam ho
explanation.md:
`while` block ke andar kuch aisa hona chahiye jo condition badle, warna loop kabhi nahi rukega:

```python
stock = 3
while stock > 0:
    print("Dispense one strip")
    stock -= 1
print("Out of stock: reorder")
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
Dispense one strip
Dispense one strip
Dispense one strip
Out of stock: reorder
```

`stock -= 1` har round mein stock ek kam karta hai. Iske bina `stock > 0` hamesha `True` rehta, aur program bina ruke `Dispense one strip` print karta rehta. Ise **infinite loop** kehte hain.

callout.title: Infinite loop mein phans gaye?
callout.md: IDE mein Stop button dabaaiye, ya terminal mein Ctrl + C. Phir dekhiye ki loop condition wale variable ko badalta hai ya nahi.

explanation.heading: break: loop abhi roko
explanation.md:
**break** loop ko turant khatam kar deta hai, bhale values bachi hon. Yeh `for` aur `while` dono mein kaam karta hai. Yahaan pharmacist pehla expired batch milne tak batches jaanchta hai:

```python
expiry_years = [2027, 2026, 2024, 2028]
for year in expiry_years:
    if year < 2025:
        print("Expired batch found:", year)
        break
    print(year, "OK")
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
2027 OK
2026 OK
Expired batch found: 2024
```

2028 kabhi jaancha hi nahi gaya: `break` seedha loop se bahar kood gaya.

Ek aam pattern hai `while True` ke saath `break`: sahi jawaab milne tak poochhte raho.

```python
while True:
    dose = int(input("Dose in mg: "))
    if dose > 0:
        break
    print("The dose must be more than 0")
print("Dose saved:", dose)
```

`while True` akele hamesha chalta; `break` hi bahar nikalne ka akela raasta hai.

explanation.heading: continue: agle round par jaao
explanation.md:
**continue** block ka baaki hissa **sirf is round ke liye** chhod deta hai, aur seedha agli value par jaata hai. Reading fail hone par thermometer kabhi-kabhi 0 save kar deta hai:

```python
temps = [37.2, 0, 38.5, 36.9]
for temp in temps:
    if temp == 0:
        print("Missing reading, skipped")
        continue
    print("Reading:", temp)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
Reading: 37.2
Missing reading, skipped
Reading: 38.5
Reading: 36.9
```

`break` loop ko hamesha ke liye chhod deta hai; `continue` bas agle round par chala jaata hai.

callout.title: while loop mein continue
callout.md: while loop mein variable ko continue se pehle update kijiye. Warna update bhi chhoot jaayega, aur loop kabhi khatam nahi hoga.

walkthrough.intro: Yeh program 100 mg dose ko har 4 ghante mein aadha karta hai, jab tak 10 mg se kam na bache, aur batata hai ki ismein kitna samay laga.

keyTerms.meaning: Jab tak yeh True hai, block dohraao.
Har half-life par amount aadha karo.
Samay gino, har round mein 4 ghante.
Loop khatam hota hai, aur agli line chalti hai.

steps.say: Yeh program tab tak dohraata hai jab tak koi condition False na ho jaaye. Humein pehle se nahi pata ki kitne rounds lagenge.
amount sau milligram se shuru hota hai.
hours zero se shuru hota hai.
while jaanchta hai: kya amount das se zyada hai? Sau hai, isliye Python block mein jaata hai.
Amount aadha hokar pachaas ho jaata hai.
Wapas while line par. Pachaas ab bhi das se zyada hai, isliye phir ghoomta hai: pachchees, phir baarah dashamlav paanch. Hours badhkar baarah.
Baarah dashamlav paanch ab bhi das se zyada hai, isliye ek round aur: chhah dashamlav do paanch milligram, solah ghante par.
Ab: kya chhah dashamlav do paanch, das se zyada hai? Nahi. Condition False hai, isliye loop khatam.

errors.intro: while, break aur continue ke saath yeh do errors aam hain.

examples.title: Value dene se pehle variable use karna
examples.md: `while` line `doses_given` ko tab jaanchti hai jab usmein kuch store hi nahi hua. Pehle shuruaati value dijiye: `doses_given = 0`.

examples.title: Loop ke bahar break
examples.md: `break` aur `continue` sirf `for` ya `while` loop ke andar kaam karte hain. Loop ke bahar rukna ho to `if-else` use kijiye.

mistakes.mistake: Condition wala variable badalna bhool jaana, jaise `stock -= 1` na likhna
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par program kabhi nahi rukta (infinite loop)
mistakes.fix: Stop dabaaiye, phir loop ke andar aisi line jodiye jo condition ko False ki or le jaaye.

mistakes.mistake: Condition ulti likhna, jaise amount 100 se shuru ho aur `while amount < 10:`
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par loop kabhi chalta hi nahi
mistakes.fix: Zor se padhiye: "jab tak amount 10 se zyada hai, dohraao" yaani `while amount > 10:`.

mistakes.mistake: while loop mein `continue` ko update se pehle rakhna, jaise `i += 1` uske neeche
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par loop ek hi value par hamesha atka rehta hai
mistakes.fix: `continue` se pehle variable update kijiye, ya for loop use kijiye.

mistakes.mistake: Ginti pata ho phir bhi counter ke saath while use karna
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par program lamba aur bigadne mein aasaan
mistakes.fix: Kitni baar, yeh pata ho to `for ... in range(...)` use kijiye.

quiz.q:
n = 1
while n < 4:
    print(n)
    n += 1

Yeh kya print karta hai?
quiz.why: Loop n = 1, 2 aur 3 ke liye chalta hai. n 4 hone par n < 4 False hai.

quiz.q: Agar while loop ke andar kuch bhi uski condition na badle to kya hoga?
quiz.why: Condition True rahe to loop ghoomta hi rehta hai.
break seedha loop se bahar koodta hai; loop ke baad wali line aage chalti hai.
continue sirf is round ke liye block ki baaki lines chhodta hai.

quiz.q: Sahi dose type hone tak poochhte rehna hai. Kaun-sa loop sabse theek hai?
quiz.why: Kitni koshishein lagengi pata nahi, isliye while (aksar while True aur break) theek hai.

quiz.q:
count = 10
while count > 10:
    print("A")

A kitni baar print hota hai?
quiz.why: Pehli hi jaanch mein 10 > 10 False hai, isliye block kabhi nahi chalta.

exam.note: Practice ke liye important questions. University ke asli questions alag ho sakte hain.

summary: **while loop** apna block **tab tak** dohraata hai jab tak condition `True` hai, har round se pehle jaanchte hue.
Values ya ginti pata ho to **for**; **kuch hone tak** dohraana ho to **while**.
`while` loop ke andar kuch condition badalna chahiye; warna **infinite loop** banta hai.
**break** loop turant chhod deta hai; `while True` aur `break` sahi jawaab milne tak poochhte rehte hain.
**continue** ek round ka baaki hissa chhodkar agle par jaata hai; while loop mein usse pehle variable update kijiye.

steps.say: Sau milligram, zero ghante par. while line poochhti hai: kya yeh das se zyada hai? Haan.
Aadha hissa nikal jaata hai, aur chaar ghante beette hain. Pachaas milligram.
Ab bhi das se zyada, isliye yeh ghoomta rehta hai: pachchees, phir baarah dashamlav paanch.
Ek baar aur aadha: chhah dashamlav do paanch, solah ghante par. Ab condition False hai.
Loop apne-aap rukta hai, aur jawaab print hota hai: solah ghante.

glossary.meaning: Aisa loop jo tab tak apna block dohraata hai jab tak condition True hai, har round se pehle condition jaanchte hue.
Aisa loop jiski condition kabhi False nahi hoti, isliye woh kabhi nahi rukta. Rokne ke liye Stop ya Ctrl + C dabaaiye.
Loop ko turant khatam karta hai; loop ke baad wali line aage chalti hai.
Sirf is round ke liye block ka baaki hissa chhodta hai, aur agle round par jaata hai.
